# Bosch Augments the Human Workforce with AI | Case Study (NiCE Cognigy)

[trafilatura 추출분]
The impact
Adopting the NiCE Cognigy platform, Bosch has constructed a powerful foundation that massively accelerates automation and capitalizes the benefits of conversational AI and generative AI within the enterprise. NiCE Cognigy is deeply integrated into the company's operational processes and proves successful across over 90 different use cases. Now with NiCE Cognigy support is more efficient, self-service is optimized, and employees have easier access to the resources they need.

[LLM-extracted supplement (WebFetch, 2026-09-27)]
Key Statistics
- 76% of sales chats for Drive & Control Technology resolved by AI on first contact
- 90+ AI agents available internally and externally
- 400K+ employees across 60+ countries
- 25 countries where ROB (HR AI agent) has been deployed

The Challenge
Bosch needed an AI orchestration platform to streamline daily tasks and implement AI agents at scale. While the company experimented with regional pilot solutions, none provided the centralized, scalable enterprise approach required.

The Solution
Bosch adopted NiCE Cognigy globally, creating "The Bosch Chatbot Suite" operated by a multitalented team across worldwide time zones.

ROB: The HR AI Agent
ROB assists employees worldwide with HR tasks including updating bank details, accessing career development information, and learning company policies. Features include:
- Multilingual support
- Context retention during conversations
- Tone-based response adjustment
- Integration with Microsoft Teams
- Continuous improvement through employee interactions

Leadership Quote
"NiCE Cognigy is by far the best solution on the market for a multinational enterprise like we are. Our goal is to free up the time of our employees to think and work more strategically." — Bosch

Results Achieved
- Accelerated automation across the enterprise
- Future-proof workforce capabilities
- Massive cost-savings
- 90+ successful AI agent implementations
- Enhanced self-service capabilities
- Improved employee access to resources
